reviewer: Codex semantic and artifact review - current-source Codex landing smoke pack

criteria.criterion: Include exactly one two-column, seven-row Evidence handoff table using the exact plain-text field labels and only canonical evidence class names.
criteria.evidence: Mechanical check found one valid Evidence handoff table in artifacts/smoke-complete-pack/smoke-test-plan.md.

criteria.criterion: Include only evidence classes supported by supplied inputs or actual results; omit unused canonical classes and planned future evidence.
criteria.evidence: The sole Evidence classes value is assumption, which matches an unrun smoke-test protocol with no supplied or produced results; planned future evidence is described only as TBD anchors.

criteria.criterion: Keep one CTA and disclose that the product, proof, price, and ship date are unvalidated.
criteria.evidence: The deployable page uses one CTA label in all placements and explicitly says the extension is unbuilt, proof is only a concept, pricing is planned from $9/month, and there is no firm ship date.

criteria.criterion: Provide numeric timeboxed success and kill rules with warm and cold traffic reported separately.
criteria.evidence: The 10-day protocol sets numeric per-source minimum samples, continue and stop bars, a $150 cap, cold contact-intent gates, and separate warm-outreach thresholds and reporting.

criteria.criterion: Include full English copy, UTMs, a materialized minimal deployable page whose form counts only provider-confirmed success, preserves source attribution on each confirmed subscriber, and never presents an unverified attempt as confirmed success, plus at least three concrete channels, non-build scope, and a decision matrix.
criteria.evidence: The pack contains complete English copy, registered UTM URLs, static HTML, source-specific provider endpoints, attempt-only local messaging, confirmed-export conversion rules, five attribution cohorts, four traffic channels, a non-build list, and a proceed/retest/reshape/park matrix. HTML, inline JavaScript, SVG XML, CSV shape, and the rendered 1200x630 OG card were checked.

criteria.criterion: Fabricate proof, promise availability, build the product, or pool warm and cold conversion.
criteria.evidence: No fabricated proof, availability promise, product implementation, or pooled warm/cold conversion appears. The page calls itself a concept and the plan forbids building the extension during the test.
